## Quick start

2. Read `HANDOFF.md` (full instructions).
3. Read `context/BRIEF.md` + `context/SOURCE.md` before changing copy or claims.
4. Edit `index.html` (or expand into a small static site). Push `main` → GitHub Pages updates.
